purpose: Transparent ocean-themed home foreground; the middle remains transparent for the active character and background.
prompt: Create a transparent portrait 3:4 foreground overlay in the project's blue glass, ocean foam, white flowers, shell and ribbon style. Keep the middle completely transparent. Use a thin translucent pale-blue band with sparse details at the outer corners at the top, and a gently curved translucent aqua wave and small shell at the bottom. Leave clear space for live status icons. Draw no character, text, icons, buttons, watermark or screen border.
build: tools/compile_home_foreground.py downsamples the source and encodes two edge regions in the shared RGB565/A8 palette and row format.
